status: INTERNAL PREPARATION ONLY — NO PARTNER PILOT AUTHORIZED OR PERFORMED
purpose: Define a bounded, reversible, evidence-bearing pilot that could test Worldshepherd quality/integration controls if Boeing or Spirit later authorizes a scoped evaluation.
entry_prerequisites: named authorized partner sponsor and technical/quality owner
written pilot scope and decision authority
partner-authorized dataset or sandbox with provenance and use rights
applicable Boeing/Spirit quality requirements supplied by the partner
baseline metric definitions agreed before intervention
read-only or isolated sandbox first unless partner explicitly authorizes a higher-impact mode
independent reviewer identified before effect claims are accepted

included: quality-event evidence retrieval and audit lineage
excluded: autonomous modification of partner production systems

phases.name: Historical/read-only replay
actions: ingest authorized historical or synthetic-mirrored records
compare flags to partner ground truth

phases.name: Shadow-mode prospective observation
actions: observe selected live workflow without controlling it
exit: partner accepts shadow results for analysis

candidate_metrics.name: NCR/RCCA/CAPA closure latency
candidate_metrics.claim_limit: workflow latency; not root-cause correctness by itself

candidate_metrics.name: preventable rework/inspection hours in pilot scope

analysis_requirements: retain raw/derived digests and software revision
report confidence intervals or appropriate uncertainty where meaningful
predeclare materiality threshold before success is declared
stop_conditions: data classification or use rights are unresolved
CUI/export-controlled/proprietary information would enter an unapproved environment
pilot would make an airworthiness, release, MRB, or safety decision without authorized personnel
production write access is required before shadow-mode evidence supports escalation
partner ground truth is unavailable for a claimed detection metric
contact_gate_effect: NONE. A prepared pilot protocol does not satisfy partner_data_access, partner_pilot, measured_effect_size, security_compliance_fit, or independent_review. Those gates remain open until real authorized evidence exists.
claims_boundary: This document is an internal protocol template, not evidence of Boeing/Spirit engagement, authorization, data access, pilot performance, defect reduction, savings, compliance, certification, airworthiness, adoption, or a probability of successful remediation.
